messages:
jamie_support: Multiple customers reporting console graphs failing to load. Tiles stuck on spinner, several 5xx/504s from analytics API. Started ~02:12 UTC. Example correlation id: cid=7f3a2b9e

lina_sre: Can you paste the browser/network error or correlation id from a failing tile?

jamie_support: Browser console shows:
```
GET https://api.redwood-inference.com/analytics/query?tile=dashboard-7 504 (Gateway Timeout)
Response: {"error":"analytics timeout", "correlation_id":"7f3a2b9e"}
```
User attached spinner screenshot and said dashboards were blank for ~10 minutes.

matt_ingest: Matching errors in analytics-proxy logs. Sample: 
```
2026-02-18T02:12:37Z ERROR analytics-proxy: upstream timeout qid=7f3a2b9e backend=clickhouse elapsed=30001ms code=504
```
Queue depth jumped and many queries hit the 30s backend timeout.

alex_platform: Noted that a config change (fanout limits) rolled at ~02:05 in PR #834. Deploy-bot shows rollout completed ~02:08.

deploy-bot: deployment analytics-proxy:v2.14 rolled at 2026-02-18T02:08:11Z via CI/CD

lina_sre: Hypothesis: fanout change either increased parallelism (overwhelmed CH) or reduced concurrency and created queueing with slow warmups. Matt, can you grab worker queue metrics + slow query tail?

matt_ingest: Slow-query tail shows many heavy GROUP BYs from dashboards, elapsed ~29.8s, client=analytics-proxy. Queue depth spiked from ~7 -> ~120 between 02:11-02:13. Autoscaler started new pods but cold KV caches caused slow warmups. Sample query snippet (sanitized):
```
SELECT ... GROUP BY rollup(...) FORMAT JSON
elapsed_ms: 29850
client: analytics-proxy
qid: 7f3a2b9e
```

alex_platform: So likely root: fanout config change opened up higher fanout and CH couldn't keep up with rollups. Options: rollback PR #834 or add temporary rate limiting on dashboard routes. Lina?

lina_sre: Immediate mitigation: add rate-limit on /analytics/query (burst=50, rate=10r/s) and bump backend timeout to 45s. If no improvement in 5m, roll back. Applying now.

lina_sre: Commands executed:
```
# gateway rate limit
kubectl -n infra exec gateway-0 -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/_admin/rate_limit -d '{"path":"/analytics/query","burst":50,"rate":10}'
# increase proxy timeout
kubectl -n analytics patch config analytics-proxy-config --patch '{"backendTimeoutMs":45000}'
```

matt_ingest: After rate-limit, queue depth dropped to ~20 and 504s decreased. ClickHouse slow queue cleared in ~2 minutes. Still rare 5xx for very heavy tiles.

jamie_support: Customers confirmed dashboards began to recover ~02:20. Some heavy aggregate tiles still intermittent. Impact: 3 enterprise tenants heavily affected; roughly 15% of dashboard loads failed during window.

alex_platform: Next steps: 1) If tuning doesn't stabilize, rollback PR #834. 2) Introduce canary for fanout changes and warmup policies for worker pods. 3) Instrument circuit-breaker and queue metrics on dashboards. Matt: collect query payloads + profiles for eng-analytics.

matt_ingest: Uploading artifacts: raw tile payloads, query plans, CH profiles, proxy logs. Will tag eng-analytics in incident.

lina_sre: Incident created: INC-2026-022 (analytics-proxy timeouts impacting console tiles). Incident page: <https://incident.redwood/INC-2026-022>

jamie_support: I've opened support tickets for affected customers: #5482, #5490, #5491. Sending interim update and offering credits if needed.

alex_platform: If we rollback, schedule ASAP and notify customers. Also add a short dashboard for queue depth, backend latency, rate-limit hits.

jamie_support: Customer asked ETA for a permanent fix. Lina/matt/alex, any timeline?

lina_sre: Short term: tuning/rollback within 30-60m if required. Medium term (1-2 weeks): canary rollout for fanout, autoscale/warmup improvements for worker pool. Will add action items to incident.

matt_ingest: Artifacts uploaded to the incident ticket; tagging eng-analytics for RCA.

jamie_support: Thanks all, will keep customers posted and close tickets when stable. :thumbsup:
